## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b02ba2dd5d4afb2de6a70005b339b85b8a44ae86`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md + AGENTS.md (the one `disarm` sentence, line 297, item 14), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md:56-57, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md:41-43, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md:12-14, scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs (the `#NNN` pattern, line 35), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (ceilings and the 120-byte line rule), scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (`--template --paths`, this record's shape). The cited files were read to judge the three `hits`, not reviewed.

Inputs read: the PR body and its one comment (6512940265, this seat's claim on this head); card #27809 body and both comments (triage 6512254201, claim 6512415848); PR #27667 comments 6510205555 (seat check, "Auto-merge stays armed"), 6510422663 (triage: owning seat disarms until a delta PASS) and 6510686343 (delta review on `af33de9c`, FAIL); `git diff origin/main...FETCH_HEAD` (3 files, +5 / −5, one commit) and `git show` of each file on `origin/main` `ddab8b996` and on the head; the 43 check-runs on the head, read twice. Merge base `fec60e00b`; `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `ddab8b996` is clean and no main commit since the base touches the three files, AGENTS.md, rest-channel.md, platform-readings.md or triage-duties.md.

Gate verdicts on the head at the second read: 43 check-runs, 0 failure; 4 still in progress: `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`. Green: `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, the three `Lint · scoped` jobs, `Type Check · source gates`, `Test Core`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` (aggregates; shards are expected skips for a `.claude/**`-only diff). This record judges the text; landing check ② is the seat's at landing time, after the four in-progress jobs report.

### ① Derived judgments

Measured against the three files on the head, not the PR body.

1. **Line counts are unchanged at every ceiling.** `contract-review.md` 60 → 60, `landing-operations.md` 101 → 101, `SKILL.md` 319 → 319 (`wc -l` on `origin/main` and on the head). Every edited line is at or under 120 bytes: contract-review.md:49 117, :50 116, :58 119; landing-operations.md:12 119; SKILL.md:200 118. Right.
2. **The rule site is one bullet, contract-review.md:49-50, under landing check ①.** Main's :49 was the regen/prose-only exception alone. The head's bullet keeps that exception (「纯重生成或只动散文面则原记录续管,落 `Regen-provenance:` 行」) and adds: any other head move, or a FAIL on the current head, while auto-merge is armed ⇒ the dispatching seat, on reading it, disarms per the AGENTS.md disarm sentence; the FAIL record names the disarm; re-arming follows ①. Right as a statement of the card and the triage comment (see ④).
3. **The disarm mechanics are a pointer, and the pointer resolves.** `grep -n -i disarm AGENTS.md` on the head returns exactly one line, 297, inside item 14's governed-surface landing paragraph: "Already armed or queued when you read this? Disable auto-merge AND convert it back to draft, which disarms an unqueued PR; no seat act ... is measured to dequeue one (platform-readings.md, queue membership), so ask the maintainer at once to remove a queued PR by hand — then confirm from the remote that it is in neither the queue nor origin/main." So 「照 AGENTS.md disarm 句」 is a unique, greppable reference, and it already carries the queued case. Right.
4. **Relay spelling and the dequeue facts agree.** rest-channel.md:56 names the reverse ops `pr_draft`/`automerge_disable`; :57 says draft-then-arm order and 「反向两 op 未实调」. platform-readings.md:41-43: converting to draft is not a reliable dequeue; dropping auto-merge on draft is seen only when unqueued; unloading auto-merge alone does not dequeue and both acts together were not seen to dequeue either (08-08, 09-28). The new text makes no claim beyond these: it points at the AGENTS.md sentence, which says do both and go to the maintainer for a queued PR. No contradiction. What changes is that two never-invoked relay ops become rule-mandated on an event (see should-fix 3).
5. **SKILL.md:197 「批准后再推亦不过期」 and the moved-head rule are about different objects.** :196-197 say the maintainer's APPROVED review (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`) is spent once per PR and survives later pushes; the new rule governs the contract-review PASS, which landing check ① already ties to the current head. A Tier H PR that is approved and armed, then moved by a main merge: the seat disarms, waits for a delta PASS or `Regen-provenance:`, then re-arms per ①, and the approval still stands, so no second approval is asked. 「踢出/变基同法」 re-lands through 落地前检, whose ① is PASS-on-current-head, so a kick or rebase is already under the same condition. Consistent.
6. **SKILL.md:200 is a pointer without the exception.** 「PASS 后 head 移 ⇒ 撤挂回等」 names every move; the regen/prose-only exemption lives only at contract-review.md:49. Main's :200 (「回等复核」) had the same shape, so this is not new, and the over-reading errs toward disarming. Not a contradiction; should-fix 2.
7. **landing-operations.md:12 pointer.** 「FAIL ⇒ 撤挂,补丁轮」 is read in the landing window (file line 3) and names the FAIL half. 「交棒请审」→「交棒」 loses nothing: SKILL.md:198 defines ③ 请审 = 席位交棒. Right.
8. **landing-operations.md:57 and :72 are untouched.** :57 (`dirty` ⇒ merge main, then arm) is the pre-arm case and is consistent as is. :72 (`dirty` ⇒ merge `origin/main` and push at once) is the exact action that moved #27667's head while armed, and it carries no pointer to the moved-head rule; the seat in the landing window reaches that rule through SKILL.md:200 and contract-review.md:49-50 only. Not a lost rule, since neither line asserts the PR stays armed; should-fix 1.
9. **The two deleted sentences are restatements, not rules.** Main :57 「卡上副本在规则外、不是要求」: with 「单载体 = PR」 retained, the card copy is by construction not a carrier; the only consumer of the label in the corpus is a PR search (dispatch-runbook.md:44 `is:pr is:open label:needs:contract-review`) and `check-owed-reviews.mjs` `WAITING_LABEL`, both PR-side. Main :60 「⛔ 无 check、workflow 或队列守卫读标记与认领/hold 行」 is kept verbatim inside the head's :58; 「入队只认同形记录,标记有无不改判」 is landing check ① (:48, PASS on the current head) plus 「⛔ 不是闸门」 (:58). The marker's three operations (挂 :59, 摘 :60, FAIL 不摘 :60) are unchanged. No rule lost.
10. **Compressions on the edited lines only.** 「只动上列散文面」→「只动散文面」 (prose faces defined once at :9-10; triage-duties.md:12 uses the same short form), 「继续管」→「续管」. Byte-exact elsewhere: `git diff` shows no other hunk. Right.
11. **No gate, script or workflow is added or changed.** The diff is three `.md` files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`. Wanted 3 is not built, matching triage 「新增门禁默认否」. Right.
12. **Precedent is not in the skills text.** scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs:35 refuses `/#[0-9]{3,}/` in the pm-dispatch corpus; #27667 and #27806 are named in the PR body and the commit message instead. Right.

### ② Semver level

Not applicable: `.claude/**` publishes nothing, the PR carries `skip-changeset`, `Check Changeset` is green on the head. No package, schema or published surface moves. Consistent.

### ③ Boundary flags

The PR body declares four deviations from the dispatch order and no `open_questions`. Each answered:

1. Precedent named in the body, not in the text: accepted, the id-lint pattern forbids it (① 12) and the rules-only ruling moved narrative out.
2. Disarm as a pointer, not a restatement: accepted. The AGENTS.md sentence is stricter than the order's wording (both ops every time, plus hand removal for a queued PR), the pointer is unique (① 3), and CLAUDE.md's single-instruction-set rule argues against a second copy.
3. Wanted 3 not built: accepted, triage 6512254201 said no new gate; the card itself says the queue guard is the maintainer's call.
4. landing-operations.md:57 and :72 untouched: accepted as not a lost rule (① 8), carried as should-fix 1 because :72 is the incident's own action.

Author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no off-relay login to note.

### ④ Design judgment

Against the card's Wanted and the triage comment, with the incident (6510205555 → 6510422663 → 6510686343 → merge `21c4bdd8` → p0 #27806) as the acceptance scenario.

- **Wanted 1 (a FAIL on the current head disarms).** Held. 「现 head 落 FAIL 而已挂 auto-merge ⇒ 派发席读到即照 AGENTS.md disarm 句撤挂,FAIL 记录点名撤挂;重挂照 ①」. The actor is the dispatching seat (派发席, the seat that ACCEPTed and armed, i.e. the owning seat), on reading the FAIL; the review seat's FAIL record names the disarm; re-arming needs a same-shape PASS on the current head (①). This is triage's narrowing of the card (owning seat, not the reviewer), and the text follows triage. Replayed on #27667: at 23:11Z the FAIL record would name the disarm owed; the owning seat's next event (any wake before 23:31Z) would read it and run the AGENTS.md sentence; with no PASS on `af33de9c`, ① forbids re-arming. The 20-minute window closes at the seat's next read rather than at the FAIL itself, which is what triage asked for.
- **Wanted 2 (a moved head disarms until a delta PASS or Regen-provenance).** Held. 「余移…而已挂 auto-merge ⇒ …撤挂;重挂照 ①」 with the regen/prose-only exception continuing under the original record plus a `Regen-provenance:` line. Replayed: `af33de9c` edited two wire pins in the conflict resolution, so it is 「余移」, not pure regeneration (triage 6510422663 said the same under triage-duties L14), and the seat's 22:41Z check would have had to disarm instead of writing "Auto-merge stays armed". SKILL.md:200 reaches every seat on every fire with the same instruction.
- **Wanted 3.** Nothing built. Right by triage.
- **Scoping to 「已挂 auto-merge」.** A PR that is not armed has nothing to disarm, and ① already forbids arming it; the condition does not narrow the rule. Queued PRs are a subset of armed ones in this repo (enable-auto-merge is the enqueue act, landing-operations.md:59-61), and the AGENTS.md sentence handles the queued case.
- **Reach of the AGENTS.md sentence.** It sits in the governed-surface paragraph; the new rule applies its mechanics to any PR under contract review, including a spec-face PR like #27667 that touches no governed path. That is an extension of where the mechanics apply, not a change to them, and the sentence is self-contained. No contradiction with AGENTS.md.
- **Internal consistency across the three files.** Checked each sentence that names arming, head moves or the marker: contract-review.md:28 (claim expires on head move), :42 (each substantive head owes a full review, findings-only commits a delta by the same reviewer), :48-50, :58-60; landing-operations.md:12, :57, :59-61, :72; SKILL.md:197-201. None contradicts the new bullet. The two softer points, SKILL.md:200 without the exception and landing-operations.md:72 without a pointer, are listed below.
- **Line budget.** The one-line cost is paid in the same file by deleting two restatements (① 9), not by re-wrapping; the ratchet ceilings and the 120-byte rule hold on every edited line (① 1).

**Must-fix:** none.

**Should-fix** (not blocking; a follow-up PR or the same patch round if the seat chooses):

1. landing-operations.md:72 is the landing-window instruction that moves an armed PR's head (`dirty` ⇒ merge `origin/main` and push), and it is the step #27667's seat ran. Give it a pointer to the moved-head rule, e.g. append 「移 head 照 contract-review.md」, paying the bytes elsewhere in the file (the file is at 101/101 and :72 is at 117 bytes, so the line needs a compression, not a new line).
2. SKILL.md:200 「PASS 后 head 移 ⇒ 撤挂回等」 names every move, while the regen/prose-only exemption lives only at contract-review.md:49. It errs toward disarming, so it is safe, but a seat reading SKILL.md alone will disarm on a byte-exact regeneration. Consider 「非例外 head 移 ⇒ 撤挂回等」 or a pointer, inside the 120-byte line.
3. rest-channel.md:57 records 「反向两 op 未实调」 for `pr_draft`/`automerge_disable`. This rule makes them mandatory on an event. The first real invocation should update that line with what was measured (whether disable alone dropped the arm on an unqueued PR), and platform-readings.md:41-43 if a dequeue is ever observed. Separate card, not this PR.
4. contract-review.md:50 「FAIL 记录点名撤挂」 reads either as "names the disarm as owed" or "confirms the disarm was done"; since the review seat writes before the owning seat acts, the first is the only one it can mean. 「点名欠撤挂」 would say so in two extra bytes, within the 116-byte line.

**VERDICT: PASS**

Inputs read: the one commit `b02ba2dd..5855983e` (`git diff`, 3 files, +4 / −4: SKILL.md 1/1, contract-review.md 2/2, landing-operations.md 1/1), its commit message, the three files whole on the new head; the seat's claim on this head (6513289169); card #27848 (should-fix 3 filed separately, `Blocked-by: #27845`, `pm:blocked`, unclaimed); the 40 check-runs on the head. `origin/main` is now `c4cb5ec0c`; merge base is still `fec60e00b`; `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` is clean; no main commit since the base touches the three files, AGENTS.md, review-checklist.md, execution-duties.md, rest-channel.md or platform-readings.md.

### What moved: `b02ba2dd` to `5855983e`

One commit, no merge. Each hunk measured on the head:

- `SKILL.md:200`. 「PASS 后 head 移 ⇒ 撤挂回等」 → 「非例外 head 移 ⇒ 撤挂回等」. 119 bytes.
- `references/landing-operations.md`. Old :64 「`Part of` 卡开着不摘 `pm:dispatched`,无在飞物的卡就永远算进 `label:pm:dispatched is:open`」 deleted; a continuation line is added under the `dirty` bullet (now :71-72): 「这一移 head 的撤挂与重挂照 `contract-review.md` head 后移例外条。」, 83 bytes, indented as a wrapped bullet in the same style as contract-review.md:49-50. Line count 101 → 101.

Line counts on the head: 60 / 101 / 319, every ceiling held.

### ① Derived judgments

Items 1 to 12 of record 6513017524 re-read against the new head. Items 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 11 and 12 stand: the text they judge is unchanged. Re-judged where the move touches:

1. **Ceilings and bytes.** 60/101/319 unchanged; the five edited or added lines are 120, 119, 119, 83 bytes and the deleted line costs nothing. Right.
6. **SKILL.md:200 now carries the exception.** 「非例外 head 移 ⇒ 撤挂回等」 resolves to contract-review.md:49, which now begins 「head 后移例外:」, the only place in the corpus that spells the exception. Dropping 「PASS 后」 loses nothing: 撤挂 presupposes an armed PR, and landing check ① says a PR is armed only after a PASS on its head, so "after PASS" was implied by "armed"; a move before any PASS leaves the PR where ① already holds it. Right; should-fix 2 of the prior record is closed.
8. **landing-operations.md:71 now points at the rule.** The `dirty` ⇒ merge-and-push step, the act that moved #27667's head, gets a continuation line sending the disarm and re-arm to the head-move exception bullet. :57 (pre-arm case) stays as is, which is correct. Should-fix 1 of the prior record is closed.
13. **The deleted :64 was a consequence statement, and its rule survives in three places.** The line said: a `Part of` card left open with `pm:dispatched` still on counts forever in `label:pm:dispatched is:open`. The imperative behind it (remove `pm:dispatched` from a `Part of` card at close-out) is stated at landing-operations.md:63 (「确认 MERGED 同一动作里给 `Part of` 卡收口…标也须摘,⛔ 不拆到下轮巡检」), at :64 on the head (「摘标换回 `pm:queue` 或按剩余物定级,加一条…评论」, the very next line, which tells the seat what the label becomes), and verbatim at review-checklist.md:12 (「`Part of` 收口的卡不会自动关,`pm:dispatched` 必须手工摘,动作要件见落地细则 B」, pointing back into this section). execution-duties.md:64 covers the partial-landing release (`Refs #N (item k)` ⇒ 回 `pm:queue` + 清 assignee), and SKILL.md:107 defines `pm:dispatched` as always paired with an assignee. What is gone is the "why" (the dispatched-query consequence), which under the rules-only ruling is narrative. No rule lost. Right.
14. **contract-review.md:50 「点名欠撤挂」.** Now says the FAIL record names the disarm as owed, which is the only thing a review seat writing before the owning seat acts can assert. Should-fix 4 of the prior record is closed. Right.
15. **Anchor consistency.** `git grep 'head 后移例外'` on the head hits exactly two lines: contract-review.md:49 「head 后移例外:」 (the definition) and landing-operations.md:72 「head 后移例外条」 (the pointer). SKILL.md:200 「非例外 head 移」 names the same exception by its negation and has no other candidate to resolve to. Right.

### ② Semver level

Stands as judged in 6513017524: not applicable, `.claude/**` publishes nothing, `skip-changeset` on the PR.

### ③ Boundary flags

The four deviations stand as accepted in 6513017524. The commit message declares nothing new. Should-fix 3 (rest-channel.md:57 「反向两 op 未实调」) is filed as #27848 with `Blocked-by: #27845`, which is the right route: it waits on the first real relay invocation and is not this PR's text. Author remains `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment

Stands as judged in 6513017524 for Wanted 1, Wanted 2, Wanted 3, the 「已挂 auto-merge」 scoping, the reach of the AGENTS.md sentence and the line budget. Re-run on the two points the move touches:

- **Replay of #27667 through landing-operations.md.** The seat in the landing window reads this file (line 3). At 22:41Z it saw `dirty`, merged `origin/main` and pushed (:71). On this head the next line (:72) tells it that this move's disarm and re-arm follow the head-move exception bullet; the bullet says a move that is not pure regeneration or prose-only, while armed, is disarmed on reading per the AGENTS.md sentence. `af33de9c` edited two wire pins, so it is 「余移」. The exception's definition stays single-sited (contract-review.md:49, with triage-duties.md:12 using the same short form), so no second copy was added.
- **Internal consistency across the three files** re-checked for every sentence that names arming, head moves, the marker or `Part of` close-out: contract-review.md:28, :42, :48-50, :58-60; landing-operations.md:12, :57, :59-64, :71-72; SKILL.md:107, :197-201. None contradicts another on this head.

**Must-fix:** none.

**Should-fix:** none left on this PR. Should-fix 3 of 6513017524 lives at #27848 (`pm:blocked` on #27845 and on the first real `automerge_disable` / `pr_draft` stroke).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：pm-dispatch 规则补两条撤挂规则，规则只落 `contract-review.md` 一处，另两处就地加指针。一、PR 已挂 auto-merge 时，当前 head 上的契约复核为 FAIL，派发席读到即撤挂（照 AGENTS.md 的撤挂句：卸 auto-merge 并转 draft，已入队者交维护者手动移出），FAIL 记录点名「欠撤挂」。二、非例外的 head 后移（如合入 main 改动了被复核面）同样撤挂，直到差量 PASS 或 `Regen-provenance:` 点名新 head；纯再生 / 纯文字的后移沿用原记录。`landing-operations.md` 的 `dirty ⇒ merge 后推送` 一条与 `SKILL.md:200` 改为指向该规则。3 个文件 +6/−6，行数不变。
- 为什么改：#27667 在 ACCEPT 后被 main 合入移动了 head，auto-merge 一直挂着；新 head 的差量复核 FAIL 后 20 分钟照样合入，main 变红（p0 #27806）。原规则只说「PASS 后 head 移 ⇒ 回等复核」，没说要撤挂。
